changes: ⚡ Performance pass on chat. Real finding: Group Chat's 5-second background poll was re-downloading the ENTIRE up-to-100-message payload — embedded images included — every single cycle, even when nothing had changed. The old "skip if unchanged" logic only ever skipped rebuilding the screen afterward, never the expensive fetch itself. Now does a tiny single-message check first and only pays for the full fetch when something's genuinely new. Tradeoff worth knowing: a reaction added to an older message won't show up via background polling anymore, only next time a new message arrives or you reopen the chat — traded for a much lighter poll, since speed was the actual complaint.

Syndy's 1:1 chat now sends a bounded 20-message window of context instead of the whole, ever-growing session history — a long conversation was genuinely getting slower and more expensive turn by turn since every reply resent the entire transcript so far.
